programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: Gross fee for the two-year programme as stated in the 2026 brochure: inclusive of tuition fee INR 14.00 lakh and a refundable caution money deposit of INR 50,000. Mess charges extra. The brochure does not name the batch.

feeSource.title: IIM Mumbai - Admissions page / MBA Programme Brochure 2026 (MBA Fee Structure)
feeSource.quote: MBA Fee Structure The gross fee applicable per student for two years programmes will be ₹ 21.00 Lakhs (inclusive of Tuition fee ₹14.00 Lakhs and Caution Money Deposit ₹50,000/-) The Caution Money Deposit will be refunded to the student on graduating from the Institute

programs.intakeNote: NIRF sanctioned intake AY 2024-25 for ALL 2-yr PG programmes (MBA, MBA-OSCM, MBA-SM) combined; flagship-MBA-only seats not officially stated in the documents reviewed.

intakeSource.title: IIM Mumbai - Submitted Institute Data for NIRF'2026'
intakeSource.quote: Sanctioned (Approved) Intake Academic Year 2024-25 2023-24 ... PG [2 Year Program(s)] 534 476

programs.salaryNote: NIRF 2026 median, graduating AY 2024-25, all 2-yr PG programmes. Final Placements Report Batch 2024-26 (https://iimmumbai.ac.in/placement/storage/files/Placement_Report_Batch_of_2026.pdf) gives only 'INR 33.0 LPA Average Median of Past 3 Years' and 'Average CTC 31.4' LPA, not a single-year median.
